intuition: Treat every index reachable in the current jump count as one layer and find the next layer's farthest boundary.

brute_force.approach: Use DP to try every reachable next index from each position.

optimal.approach: Scan each greedy reachability layer once, extending its farthest endpoint and counting a jump at each boundary.

edge_cases: A one-element array needs zero jumps.
The problem guarantees the last index is reachable.
